description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for batch-wise, progressive processing of large item collections in React applications. It manages UI state such as progress and supports cancelation and auto-cancel on component unmount. The code handles scheduling work via `requestIdleCallback` with fallback to `setTimeout`, and is designed to execute work in batches to keep the UI responsive.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches progressively, respecting time budgets and allowing cancelation.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that manages starting, progress tracking, and canceling the batch processing of items in a React component.
